label.purpose: Short system facts and code-adjacent labels.

shadows.name: light-response
shadows.purpose: Semantic focus, connected state, and primary hover only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Restrained state transitions and identity resolution.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The singular glacial-white action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 13px; background: var(--mind-ice); color: var(--mind-black); font: 560 0.74rem var(--font-body); } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--mind-white); box-shadow: 0 0 8px color-mix(in oklch, var(--mind-ice) 34%, transparent); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mind-ice); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action for reversible or supporting work.
components.css: .ds-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--mind-border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 13px; background: transparent; color: var(--mind-muted); font: 560 0.74rem var(--font-body); } .ds-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--mind-border-strong); color: var(--mind-ice); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mind-ice); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A near-black field with a precise focus edge.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 320px; border: 1px solid var(--mind-border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 10px; background: var(--mind-black-soft); color: var(--mind-text); font: 0.8rem var(--font-body); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--mind-ice); outline: 2px solid var(--mind-ice); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation Item
components.description: A familiar navigation row whose active state collects light.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { width: 180px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 10px; background: var(--mind-surface-raised); color: var(--mind-ice); font: 0.8rem var(--font-body); text-align: left; } .ds-nav-active:hover { color: var(--mind-white); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mind-ice); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Conversation Composer
components.description: A physically anchored but quiet writing surface.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; width: 520px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border: 1px solid var(--mind-border-strong); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 8px 12px 15px; background: var(--mind-black-soft); color: var(--mind-muted); font: 0.9rem var(--font-body); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--mind-ice); } .ds-composer button { width: 31px; height: 31px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--mind-ice); color: var(--mind-black); }

narrative.overview: VOID Mind feels like a silent observatory at night: the room disappears, one cold instrument surface remains readable, and light collects only where attention is required. Darkness is the environment. Light is the interface.
keyCharacteristics: Near-absolute black regions with almost no visible container edge.
Glacial-white state, focus, identity, and primary action light.
Proportional reading typography with mono reserved for short technical labels and code.
Restrained, state-driven motion with immediate reduced-motion resolution.

rules.name: The Darkness Rule
rules.body: Large regions remain black. A medium-gray application shell is prohibited.

rules.name: The Earned Light Rule
rules.body: White light indicates identity, focus, selection, active generation, or a primary action.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Conversation prose is never forced into monospace.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Active Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use tone, spacing, or a hairline.

dos: Do keep the environment at near-absolute black and reserve surfaces for functional hierarchy.
Do use glacial white for focus, active state, identity, and primary action.
Do expose clear hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't build a gray-card dashboard or dense three-column inspector.
Don't use CRT scanlines, noise grids, phosphor, terminal green, or dense monospace telemetry.
Don't use permanent RGB text, cyberpunk neon, continuous glitch, or glowing controls everywhere.
